decision_description: Phase 4 milestone-schedule design decision for the FIELDWISE ATK-hosted run. The primary water-status model is frozen at MS6 (due_month 3, criterion: model parameters fixed and model card D2.1 registered) BEFORE the first prospective commercial field season, which begins with the WP3 measurement campaigns (T3.3/T3.4 from M6). MS6 falls chronologically second (M3) yet retains its non-sequential identifier rather than being renumbered ahead of MS2 (M14); the six milestones (MS1 M2, MS6 M3, MS2 M14, MS3 M18, MS4 M24, MS5 M30) preserve their original IDs while being ordered by due_month. The full 30-month timeline (WP1 M1-14, WP3 M4-18, WP4 M1-24, WP5 M25-30) fits within the operator-confirmed project_duration_months = 30, and every milestone carries a verifiable criterion (confirmed by validation report milestone_consistency_gantt_designer_2026-09-02T11:43:00Z, 6/6 consistent, 0 flagged).
alternatives_considered: Freeze the primary model later (after WP3 field observations begin), letting field data inform model selection — rejected because the prospective validation must apply a model frozen independently of the commercial-field data it is tested against (T2.3 -> T3.5 critical-path dependency).

Renumber the milestones into strict chronological order (making the M3 freeze 'MS2') — rejected in favour of preserving original milestone identifiers under the run-03 id-stability rule, so downstream references remain stable across regeneration.

Omit an explicit model-freeze milestone and rely on the D2.1 deliverable due_month alone — rejected because a verifiable, dated freeze checkpoint is required to make the independence of the prospective validation auditable.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 4 gate condition (all milestones have a defined verifiable criterion; timeline fits within the call-specified duration; no critical path dependency unresolved)
rationale: The MS6-before-field-season freeze is dictated by the Tier 3/Tier 4 work-package dependency structure (docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase3_wp_design/wp_structure.json critical_path T2.3 -> T3.5 -> T4.3 -> T5.1, edge T2.3 -> T3.5 data_input): the WP3 prospective validation at the independent commercial farm derives its scientific value from applying a model whose parameters were fixed before that site's data existed, so the freeze checkpoint must precede WP3 campaign onset. The 30-month bound is the operator-Confirmed project fact in Tier 3 (docs/tier3_project_instantiation/call_binding/selected_call.json project_duration_months = 30, a 24-month European Fellowship at HUN-REN ATK plus a 6-month AgroVIR placement under CC-07), well within the call-level maximum of 36; WP5 ends exactly at M30, satisfying the CLAUDE.md §7 timeline-within-duration gate condition. Milestone identifiers are preserved rather than renumbered to keep the schedule reproducible and auditable across the run-03 regeneration (id-stability rule, decision_log/fieldwise-run03-instantiation_2026-09-02.json), consistent with CLAUDE.md §9.5. MS1's criterion referencing formal acceptance by the primary supervisor names Prof. Tibor Janda, reflecting the 2026-09-02 supervisor re-targeting recorded in Tier 3 consortium/roles.json.
